identity.title: Qualify and publish the first release through three ordered phases

origin.summary: The owner requested a current-state self-evaluation, a three-phase development and distribution specification, and immediate progress on the first phase.

state.current_summary: Frozen commit c1b49ec, its clean D-backed package and hashed ZIP, local automated gates, and hosted Windows CI #94 pass. Phase 1 remains active only because product-owner unaided Wide and Compact R0 is outstanding.
state.next_action: The product owner completes unaided Wide and Compact R0 on the exact c1b49ec package and records any release-blocking defect before deciding whether Phase 2 may begin.

objective.summary: Qualify and publish the first stable OpenVisionLab 3D Studio release through internal freeze, limited RC, and stable-publication gates with exact package identity and truthful capability boundaries.
constraints: Preserve explicit Preview, Publish, Run, Validation, source/result separation, stable evidence identities, and save/reopen behavior.
Do not add camera, PLC, robot, cloud, production-line, calibrated metrology, installer, or unrelated feature scope during release qualification.
Do not change the product version, create or push a tag, create a GitHub Release, or distribute externally without the explicit approval required by the owning phase.
Require product-owner unaided Wide and Compact R0 on the exact frozen candidate before Phase 2.

Store new local test and package evidence physically under D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab-3D-Studio; do not move or delete existing E-backed artifacts without explicit approval and verified migration.
Do not claim calibrated measurement, Gauge R&R, production approval, or resolution of PL-0003 without current evidence.

criteria.text: The current maturity, blockers, included and excluded release scope, three ordered phases, approval boundaries, and defect policy are documented from current evidence.

Phase 1 freezes one exact clean 0.1.1-dev commit and D-backed self-contained package whose manifest, payload, licenses, samples, documentation, sizes, SHA-256 values, full release gate, and hosted CI pass.
The product owner completes unaided Wide and Compact R0 on the exact Phase 1 candidate with no unresolved critical or high release defect.
After explicit approval, Phase 2 publishes and reads back a limited 0.1.1-rc.1 and passes the packaged operator workflow in a clean Windows environment outside the development checkout.
After explicit approval, Phase 3 publishes v0.1.1 and proves exact tag, commit, manifest, downloaded size and SHA-256, tutorial workflow, release notes, licenses, and known-limitations parity.
The stable release makes no calibrated-metrology or excluded-platform claim and records the PL-0003 and signing decisions before publication.

evidence.observation: At main 60f86973a117674017f79317e9219b13433a5491, product version is 0.1.1-dev, the solution lists 14 projects, tracked and loose DLL counts are zero, PL-0026 records MVVM M1-M7 complete with structure 67/67, and hosted Windows CI run 32434992738 completed successfully.

Current GitHub API and remote-tag checks return zero releases and zero tags; the default package manifest is absent; the repository artifacts junction resolves to E:\OpenVisionLab-3D-Studio\artifacts while the required D-backed test root exists.

The current specification records the evidence-based readiness matrix, internal freeze, limited RC, stable release phases, entry and exit gates, severity policy, exact approval boundaries, and current storage/R0/publication blockers.

FullVerification environment check passed all 5 required tools; PL-0029 validates as v2; changed-document local links report zero missing; git diff --check passes. The environment script also emitted its fixed repository-local report through the existing E-backed artifacts junction, reproducing the storage-path constraint without moving or deleting existing data.

The new OutputRoot boundary parses, rejects mixed OutputRoot/OutputDirectory and repository-output escape, and publishes Release output directly to D with exit 0. Required application files pass 11/11; all 506 manifest entries match actual lengths and SHA-256 values; the 507-file package totals 242,409,450 bytes; manifest SHA-256 is AAD83CBEEC0F1D63C617F808EA081A3E18AD79E31A7BE5C722BFDE13B6B58320. The manifest truthfully records 0.1.1-dev, commit 60f8697, and dirty tree, so this is not a frozen candidate. A direct dotnet Shell.dll help probe entered the interactive path and was stopped; actual packaged EXE and owner R0 remain unverified.

Frozen commit c1b49eca7726f9a07d537403b07fbd0a4ab9da64 produced a clean 0.1.1-dev package. Required files pass 11/11; all 506 manifest entries match size and SHA-256; 507 package files total 242,409,310 bytes; manifest SHA-256 is 456F680B343A4DF27149D0C7408408021F29AD3786C2604EFAE2B6F7D43AEF94. The 108,090,330-byte internal ZIP SHA-256 is EBEF0E6A6EC76A87820021A616B8CE13606BD11BB587EB1787AC4FE59C5475C8. Release build passed with zero warnings/errors; structure 67/67, vendored packages, NuGet health, selected Runner/golden, and current Shell contracts passed locally. GitHub Actions run 32450458521 (#94) passed all 55 recorded steps on the exact commit. Product-owner Wide/Compact R0 remains unperformed.

events.summary: Use three ordered gates: internal 0.1.1-dev qualification and owner R0, explicitly approved limited 0.1.1-rc.1, then public v0.1.1 only after RC exit and exact public readback.
Keep Phase 1 doing after non-destructive preflight passes; do not generate the candidate package through the current E-backed artifacts junction until a safe D-backed output route is approved.

Accept the explicit OutputRoot route and dirty-tree D-backed package as Phase 1 path/composition preflight only; require a committed clean rebuild, full release gate, and owner R0 before freezing the candidate.

Freeze c1b49ec and its exact D-backed package/archive as the Phase 1 automated qualification candidate; require product-owner unaided Wide and Compact R0 before any Phase 2 version or publication decision.
